before.critic: Dense wide networks surrounded most UV plates and read as an orange wireframe ball.

intermediate_rejections: Sparse continuous Voronoi remained an overly uniform honeycomb.
Open-ended Y paths became rounded painted worms/runes.
The first broad-valley pass had too few giant plates and flat single-value orange channels.

final.reference_direction: Connected broad recessed valleys separating irregular planetary-crust plates; pattern judged against the user attachment only.
final.repair: Strongly warped low-frequency primary network, sparse localized plate splits, variable-width profiled shoulders/inner channels, and authored shader-only recession/rock relief.

mask_metrics.note: The deterministic threshold is below the original 15-25% planning target because profiled dark shoulders are intentionally low intensity; fixed and custom renders govern the visual decision.

unity.emission_source: sRGB #FF5A24 converted to linear, then multiplied by 1.35

final.visual_verdict: conditional pass from root for the pattern; retained for Unity validation
